key.topic: (e) class of a code letter: tie-breaker clause vs the EMAAR/Mirage legend

dispositions.reason: The critic is right that the (e) tie-breaker, read mechanically, makes Mirage/EMAAR C ('Not Approved (Re-submit within 14 days)') a rejection option because D ('Incomplete, Resubmit') is a separate revise option, which contradicts the ruling's own consequence and the F025 rows. The F025 class revise and resubmit is right on the page: C carries its own resubmission instruction. The tie-breaker is reworded so it applies only to options worded 'Rejected' (keeps 'Rejected / Resubmit' = rejected, which the critic's proposed wording would have flipped), and the Mirage legend is stated to override the 'not approved' marker of frozen section 5. No page or document row changes; F025 p1/p3/p4 stay revise and resubmit.
